discovered_issues.title: DI-27-01 deferred: Phase 1 shallow sink extraction prevents path_reachable from scoring REST EP findings
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: CONFIRMED. Gate _check_path_reachable() looks up sinks_by_ep[ep_id] which only contains sinks extracted DIRECTLY from the REST callback body (shallow extraction). REST EP callbacks are thin dispatchers — they call business logic methods 1-2 hops down. Actual dangerous sinks (e.g., option updates, file ops) live in downstream methods. Phase 1 IR only captures the direct 'return' statement in the callback as a sink (category: output_return). Agent-a3 claims downstream sink functions. Gate finds no match → sink_ok=False. Source check also fails when agent specifies a source_function that doesn't match IR source variable names → source_ok=False. Result: path_reachable=0.25 for all REST EP TP findings. COMPOSITE: (A) sink mismatch (main), (B) source expression mismatch (secondary). Evidence: IR ep_rest___getblock has only function_called='return'; agent claims a different sink. ep_rest_backwpup_v1__startbackup has wp_delete_file and update_site_option in IR but agent claims 'jobadapter::get_jobrun_url' — no match.
discovered_issues.fix_path: Extend Phase 1 PHP extractor (IRBuilder.php or EntryPointVisitor.php) to follow 1 hop from REST EP callback body into dispatched methods and collect their sinks attributed to the same entry_point_id. Handle common patterns: method calls, static calls. Requires PHP source changes + full Phase 1 rerun + Phase 3 rerun.
discovered_issues.fix_complexity: MEDIUM — estimated 50-100 lines PHP + test coverage. Requires careful scoping to avoid circular call resolution.
discovered_issues.severity: HIGH — blocks all backwpup REST EP TP findings from reaching PLAUSIBLE
affects: backwpup REST EP findings (16 of 22 UNCERTAIN)
